svg.title: UMBRA superscalar architecture
svg.desc: Logical datapath and selected control connections. Each ALU execution group includes its own rv32i_branch_cmp; core logic checks prediction direction and target. Dispatch allocates load/store entries, updates the return stack and sets CSR serialization state. Retirement qualifies committed-map, free-list, CSR and load/store effects; trace outputs are observation only. Store-data snooping uses ROB-accepted CDB writes.
svg.text: cleared by CSR commit, branch recovery or trap flush
ALU0 x2, ALU1 x2, AGEN x2, MD x1
both lanes: direction / exact target mismatch
conditional training selects ALU0, then ALU1
exec operands: alu0/alu1 a,b - md a,b - agen a,b
accepted CDB writeback: wb_result, wb_rob_idx, wb_rob_seq -> ROB mark, PRF value + ready, SQ data snoop
core-qualified commit_fire + ROB retirement payload / trace

g.text: slot 0 CSR commit: we / waddr / wdata
